flows.FLOW-RUN-02-HAND: The single write surface in this verification set: one workflow_dispatch of harness-eval with NO inputs beyond optionally install_mode — creating a run is the product acting. Banned: dispatching any other workflow, passing fixture/debug inputs that could alter mode selection, dispatching from a fork or non-main ref, and inferring success from the run's conclusion (fail-closed cursor failure is the expected day-one state). The result must record event workflow_dispatch and install_mode matching the invocation; a mode/identity disagreement fails the flow (R-mode-mixup guard).
